transcript: The same deck can feel like a product launch, a quiet documentary, or a punchy social clip. It all depends on how it moves.
Your content stays yours. The look changes the framing, the motion, how text arrives, where captions sit, and the overall texture.
These are directions, not presets. Clean and corporate suits training. Calm and cinematic suits brand stories. Bold and energetic competes for attention in a feed.
Three questions narrow it down. Where will people watch? What one word should they feel? And how much text is on your slides? Denser slides need a clean or calm direction.
On your launch page, the headline gets slow, confident movement. Cut to three slides for social, and it becomes: Scheduling. Sorted. Same brand, two videos.
Decide the direction, then see it. On Pro, AI directs your video, shaping each scene to your tone. Try Basic first, no subscription needed, at powerpoint2vid.com.
